<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“If I am to oppose Zakareth, then let me oppose him while there is still time,”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 16}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Zakareth Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[King Zakareth the Sixth|Zakareth the Sixth]] is the King of [[Cana]] and [[Damasca]], holding the titles [[Lord]] of the Morning and Evening [[Star]]. A powerful figure with a lineage of kings, he possesses one blue eye and one that burns with scarlet flame. He is the [[Incarnation of Ragnarus]], a status that grants him deep knowledge of weapons within the Vault and the ability to perceive scarlet potential in living beings. Zakareth is a formidable combatant who utilizes weapons such as a spear and the [[Lightning Spear]]. His leadership is characterized by strategic aggression; he has been known to plan the systematic [[destruction]] of territory outposts to isolate cities. He views the people of [[Enosh]] as a dangerous cult serving the [[Incarnations]] and seeks to direct power toward specific purposes. Zakareth has also been involved in significant historical events, including the sealing of an inmate into a prison intended for nine. Despite his history of sacrificing lives to protect people from [[Incarnations]], he has transitioned into becoming an [[Incarnation]] himself. He maintains a cold and authoritative demeanor, often treating others—including his daughter [[Leah]]—with businesslike detachment or intense scrutiny.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Zakareth possesses a pale, sunken face featuring an empty eye socket hidden by an eyepatch. His skin is marked with softly glowing red and gold patterns, and he wears [[chains]] wrapped around most of his shoulders. He is adorned with a tall, spiked crown containing a flaring [[ruby]] and carries a [[ruby]]-headed staff.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As the [[King of Damasca]], he is a ruler whose will is followed by his soldiers. He values the [[blood]] of [[Ragnarus Traveler|Ragnarus Travelers]] and harbors a fear that transforming into another [[Incarnation]] might threaten his family. His motivations include a desire to control [[Indirial]] using the Rod and a plan to attack [[Enosh]] to destroy [[Alin]] and [[Elysia]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Zakareth wields a spear as his weapon. His red eye may grant him the power to see into minds, and his left eye socket contains swirling crimson flames. He also utilizes a [[ruby]]-headed staff.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Palace of Damasca}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Zakareth, the father of [[Talos]], lived without any knowledge of the [[Pillar of Sunset]]'s existence.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c2">''City of Light'', chapter 2</ref> While watching over his people from atop his palace, he eventually faced the gates of [[Cana]] supported by the [[Incarnations]] of [[Helgard]] and [[Lirial]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c11">''City of Light'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c15">''City of Light'', chapter 15</ref> His appearance is marked by a tall, spiked crown, a [[ruby]]-headed staff, and [[chains]] wrapped nearly all the way around his shoulders.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17">''City of Light'', chapter 17</ref> His physical form features skin with glowing red and gold patterns, a right eye that has turned red, and a left eye composed of swirling crimson flames.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c20">''City of Light'', chapter 20</ref> Despite having his [[steel]] and [[Nye essence]] completely depleted, he feared that transforming into another [[Incarnation]] would threaten his family.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17" /> Zakareth sought to use the Rod to control [[Indirial]], who was working for him, by making him an [[Incarnation]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c19">''City of Light'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref> After feeling the pulse of [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]]'s power from the hill where [[Leah]] stood, he chose not to attack [[Simon]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21">''City of Light'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|War against Enosh}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] prepared an attack against [[Enosh]] with the intent to destroy both [[Alin]] and [[Elysia]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25" /> He was expected to lead an army alongside his [[Incarnations]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26">''City of Light'', chapter 26</ref> [[Cynara]] made mention of the King in connection to her own power, noting that he possessed fire within his left eye socket.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref> Although Zakareth believed he would return in either three hundred or a thousand years, [[Simon]] ultimately decapitated him.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" />}}
